text: U.S. stock markets traded mixed on Monday, August 24, 2026, as the Dow Jones Industrial Average posted modest gains while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite declined due to weakness in the technology sector. Investors remained cautious, rotating into defensive sectors like consumer staples, financials, and utilities while weighing concerns over artificial intelligence valuations, upcoming Nvidia earnings, and potential U.S. economic sanctions against Iran. Technology—specifically semiconductor stocks—lagged the broader market, while energy and industrial stocks also faced downward pressure.
